highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates the bundled engine and broadens platform support while fixing stream and encoding behavior.
highlights_body: This unreleased line adds Uno Platform 7 compatibility, modernizes Apple and Windows support, and improves the reliability and efficiency of managed interop, image, stream, and text paths.

bullets.detail: Refreshes the bundled Skia engine with the latest upstream Chrome m156 bug fixes and updates the GN toolchain used to build it.
Uses native-compatible boolean representations for Skia stream callbacks and HarfBuzz font and Unicode callbacks, improving callback reliability across platforms.

bullets.lead: String and data conversion made safer
bullets.detail: Validates single-character text conversion correctly and creates null-terminated native data without reading beyond the managed buffer.
Avoids an unnecessary intermediate allocation when copying image pixels and releases retained front-buffered managed streams correctly.
Coordinates Android GL texture rendering with display refresh to provide smoother visual updates.
Pools UTF-32 conversion buffers and formats feature strings without allocating unmanaged memory, reducing overhead in text shaping workflows.
Updates SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI and its native asset integration for Uno Platform 7.
Raises iOS and tvOS deployment targets to 14.0 and aligns native Apple builds with current platform toolchains.

bullets.lead: WebGPU and native dependencies packaged consistently
bullets.detail: Includes the WebGPU implementation in WebAssembly native assets, resolves bundled HarfBuzz locally on Linux, and aligns Windows native dependencies with current MAUI releases.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: WebGPU packaging for WebAssembly and Uno Platform 7 support
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Linux bundled-HarfBuzz loading and Blazor CPU sample test stabilization
